label: College teammates
why_this_fixture: The demo-path idea (plan §23.1). A crowded student-app space where the obvious answers (ratings, LinkedIn for students, skills matching) are easy to reach for, so it exposes a model that only rewords the predictable direction.

problem.statement: Students cannot tell in advance who will actually do the work on a group project
problem.importance: A teammate who disappears can cost a whole semester grade, and there is no way to see it coming

needs: A way to judge reliability before committing to a team
behaviors: Form teams through group chats and word of mouth

product.description: An app that helps college students find reliable teammates for hackathons and side projects

assumptions: Most users are second and third year students
